basic_info.description: First time on the market in nearly 50 years and set on a large 3,598 square foot lot, this exceptional fully detached 1923 home, lovingly cared for by only two owners, showcases timeless craftsmanship and breathtaking sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean, Golden Gate Park, and the historic Windmills. Elegant period detail throughout includes 8.5 foot ceilings, wood-paneled walls, thick wood moldings, windows framed in detailed millwork, vintage lighting, oak hardwood floors, softwood floors and bay windows. The spacious layout offers three bedrooms and two full bathrooms on the main floor, a lower floor large family room/media room, home office, & third full bathroom, perfect for modern living. The remodeled kitchen, formal living room with classic woodburning fireplace and formal dining room, and large garage with interior access add to the home's appeal. Incredible storage, enormous attic and laundry area with washer/dryer and sink. Outdoor spaces include two view decks, patio, yard & beautifully landscaped front & rear gardens with drought-tolerant plants. This sun-drenched coastal home is located in San Francisco's scenic family-friendly Outer Richmond neighborhood near Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Sutro Heights Park, Lands End & local cafes & restaurants along Balboa St.
